bidder_name: 360 Capital Group Limited and 360 Capital FM Limited (as RE of 360 Capital Investment Trust), via 360 Capital ED1 Pty Limited
failure_reason: other: target board said reject; offer went unconditional on 24 Feb 2021 but 360 reached only 20.22% and let it lapse at the 31 Mar 2021 close
notes: Re-bid by 360 Capital after its 27 Oct 2020 proposal (AU-2020-20) failed its AGM pre-condition. New and improved unsolicited off-market bid announced 11 Dec 2020: A$0.30 cash plus two TGP stapled securities per five EP1 shares, less later dividends; 360 put the implied value at A$0.69 on the TGP close of A$0.965 on 10 Dec 2020 (13% above the first offer's A$0.61; also quoted 32% to the A$0.52 close on 26 Aug 2020 and 30% to the 30-day VWAP of A$0.53; none labelled undisturbed, so undisturbed_price and premium are blank). No minimum acceptance or financing condition. Equity value computed: A$0.69 x 234.6m EP1 shares on issue (target's statement), so about A$161.9m including 360's own 45.9m shares. Takeovers Panel application by EP1 (21 Dec 2020) ended when the Panel accepted an undertaking and declined to conduct proceedings (19 Jan 2021). Replacement bidder's statement 18 Jan 2021, despatched about 4 Feb 2021; EP1 target's statement 19 Feb 2021 (board unanimously recommended reject; no independent expert seen). Offer declared free of all defeating conditions on 24 Feb 2021 with 360 at 19.70% voting power; closed 7pm 31 Mar 2021 with 360 at 20.22%, and the board let it lapse. 360 sold its EP1 stake on 29 Jun 2021. Mirror dates are UTC; dates here follow the document text.
